en.headline: Para Site’s 8th International Conference explores speculative tech futures at HKU today
en.dek: The free full-day event titled “Unsubscribe All!” runs from 10:30 a.m. to 6 p.m. at Wang Gungwu Lecture Hall, bringing together artists and thinkers from Hong Kong and abroad.
body: Para Site presents its 8th International Conference on Sunday at the University of Hong Kong, under the title “Unsubscribe All!”. The one-day programme examines how speculative practices are reshaping relationships with technology in a mediated present.

The free event, which requires advance registration, takes place from 10:30 a.m. to 6 p.m. at Wang Gungwu Lecture Hall in the Graduate House. It convenes participants including Stanley Qiufan Chen, Iris Long, Bahar Noorizadeh, Clara Che Wei Peh, Sophie Penkethman-Young, Charis Poon, Winnie Soon, Ziyang Wu, Günseli Yalcinkaya and Liam Young.

Morning sessions focus on how practitioners and digital subcultures use language, storytelling and world-building to intervene in technological cultural realities. Afternoon discussions turn to access, agency and collective action across the Asia-Pacific, highlighting open-source cultures and collaborative networks. The conference is conducted in English and is open to anyone interested in alternative ways of living with technology.

Para Site said the gathering invites participants to question dominant narratives of the future and reimagine present possibilities. The organisers, Yuanyu Li and Stefan Luk, framed the day as an opportunity to unsubscribe from predetermined technological trajectories.

zh.headline: Para Site第八屆國際研討會今於港大探討科技推想未來
zh.dek: 名為「更新預設」的全日免費活動於上午10時半至下午6時在港大研究生堂王賡武講堂舉行，匯聚本地及海外藝術家與思想家。
body: Para Site藝術空間今日（23日）於香港大學舉行第八屆國際研討會，主題為「更新預設」（Unsubscribe All!），探討推想實踐如何重新塑造人們與科技的關係。
活動全日免費，需預先登記，時間為上午10時半至下午6時，地點為研究生堂王賡武講堂。講者包括陳楸帆、龍星如、Bahar Noorizadeh、白其薇、Sophie Penkethman-Young、潘雋希、孫詠怡、武子楊、Günseli Yalcinkaya及Liam Young等。
上午環節聚焦藝文工作者與數碼次文化如何運用語言、敘事及建構世界的策略，介入科技發展交織的文化現實。下午則討論亞太地區的資源獲取、能動性與集體行動，以及開源文化與協作網絡如何孕育更公平的生態系統。研討會以英語進行，歡迎任何對另類科技生活感興趣的人士參加。
Para Site表示，活動邀請參與者質疑未來的主流論述，重新想像當下的可能。策劃人李沅鈺與陸其叡將這天定位為「取消訂閱」既定科技軌跡的機會。
